snippet.title: Bear Storming (1992) [MS-DOS]
snippet.description: Remember the arcade machine in the bar in Moon City from the game "Putt-Putt Goes to the Moon"? Here's Bear Stormin'! Try collecting balloons for fuel reloads and avoid all others!
